newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee mixed in quiet pre-holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee mixed in quiet pre-holiday trade.

text.p: LIFFE coffee futures last traded mixed in featureless business, traders said.
Volume was minimal, with crosses bumping up the level of activity, they said.
January-March and March-May crosses were active, they said.
Front month January 1997 was the busiest contract, trading 817 lots of a total 1,839. It last traded down $3 at $1,287.
The biggest fall was for March which last traded $5 lower at $1,238 on volume of 626 lots.
Biggest rise was for November 1997, which last traded $10 stg higher at $1,235.
